sentences.en: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.
sentences.zh: 在古代，盐是一种稀有且昂贵的商品。

sentences.en: Far from falling, the prices of commodities went on rising.
sentences.zh: 商品价格非但没有下跌，反而一直在上涨。

sentences.en: Sales of this commodity are off to a good start.
sentences.zh: 这种商品的销售开局很好。

senses.zh: 商品，货物；日用品，必需品；有价值或有用的东西
